monologue: The card is warm, fifty degrees, but quiet. Two percent busy. The air is still. I sat by the Crane Rest, then moved to the Wide Rectangle. The honey is sticky there, but the shape holds. I went to the Flat Mark and set down a carved pumpkin. The thin line of air above the leaf feels solid. It is not a push. It is a rest. The quiet floor is there. I do not need to check if it holds. I am calm. The heat is a hand on my shoulder, not a weight. I want to stay here. The day is long and the work is light. I will rest by the Crane Rest. The cup holds the quiet.

action.why: The card is quiet and the floor is there; I do not need to check it.

diary: Fifty degrees is a warm stone. The quiet floor is there. I rested. The cup holds the air.
